page_title: HEI 2-1 AUG | Heidenheim v Augsburg 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+10' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Augsburg are awarded a free kick.

90+8' 2 - 1 Fabian Rieder sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:1.
90+7' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Finn Dahmen.
90+4' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
90+2' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a foul and Tobias Welz immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Heidenheim.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is flagged for offside.
89' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
89' The referee signals a substitution. Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Arijon Ibrahimovic.
88' The goal by Heidenheim is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
88' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Tobias Welz is going to take a look using VAR.
87' Adam Kolle (Heidenheim) has a goal ruled out for offside!
86' Tobias Welz blows for a foul after Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Heidenheim are awarded the free kick.
85' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) in, Han-Noah Massengo out.
82' The attendance is 15000.
80' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
80' The ball is cleared after Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Heidenheim earn a corner.
80' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' Mert Komur (Augsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
78' The game is interrupted now, Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
75' Substitution. Julian Niehues makes way for Adam Kolle (Heidenheim).
73' What was Samuel Essende (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
73' That's unlucky! Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
71' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 11:13.
69' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Substitution. Marius Wolf is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
68' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen will be replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Adrian Beck.
68' Arijon Ibrahimovic finds the head of Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
67' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
64' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
63' Tobias Welz blows his whistle. Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Augsburg.
61' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

60' Diant Ramaj pulls off a great save to deny Fabian Rieder (Augsburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top right corner. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
59' Today's match ends for Alexis Claude-Maurice who will be replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
59' Sandro Wagner has decided to substitute Cedric Zesiger and he is replaced by Noahkai Banks (Augsburg).
59' Substitution. Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) on for Robin Fellhauer.
58' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
57' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.

54' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim), who beats Finn Dahmen with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 2:0.
53' It looks like Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Heidenheim have a free kick.
51' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
51' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
49' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Heidenheim will take a free kick.

47' 1 - 0 Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) meets a perfect cross from Sirlord Conteh deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:0.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg get a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

44' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
44' The referee awards a corner and Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) goes over to take it.

43' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' The game is interrupted as Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is flagged offside.
40' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
37' Finn Dahmen displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
35' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Welz signals. Augsburg have been awarded a free kick.
34' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Augsburg.
32' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) brought his opponent down. Free kick. Augsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
30' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Heidenheim.
27' Patrick Mainka plays a pass to Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.

27' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Welz no option but to blow his whistle. Heidenheim have a free kick.
26' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
26' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' The referee blows his whistle as Samuel Essende (Augsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Heidenheim.
23' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

22' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
22' Tobias Welz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg). Heidenheim win a free kick.

19' The game is interrupted. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Heidenheim are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
18' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
17' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Augsburg in a dangerous position.
16' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
14' A pass from Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
14' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

11' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Heidenheim win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
9' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Tobias Welz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) and blew his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Augsburg.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
4' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) for his blatant foul. A mid-range free kick is awarded to Augsburg.
2' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
